Basic Information for CVE-2026-42037 Vulnerability Information Axios: CRLF Injection in multipart/form-data body via unsanitized blob.type in formDataToStream Overview Axios versions 1.0.0 to 1.15.1 (exclusive) do not filter CRLF (\\r\\n) in value.type within the FormDataPart constructor in lib/helpers/formDataToStream.js, directly concatenating it into the Content-Type header of each part in multipart, allowing arbitrary MIME headers to be injected and bypassing request header protection in Node.js v18+. Affected Versions Axios 1.0.0 to 1.15.0 Details Affected code: FormDataPart constructor in lib/helpers/formDataToStream.js. Root cause: value.type (the type property of Blob/File objects) is inserted into the Content-Type header of the multipart part without escaping. Attack prerequisite: The attacker can control the .type value (e.g., by constructing a malicious Blob/File when uploading files in a Node.js proxy service). Exploitation method: Inject \\r\\n in .type to add extra MIME headers or forge structure, altering the format of the multipart body. Bypass mechanism: Since the injection occurs inside the multipart body rather than in the HTTP request headers, Node.js v18+ header protection does not take effect. Impact Allows injection of arbitrary headers into the multipart/form-data request body, enabling manipulation of the request body structure. Potentially triggers attacks such as HTTP request smuggling, response splitting, or bypassing server-side parsing logic. Fixed in version 1.15.1. Have questions about the vulnerability?
